finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake said, intent on also making himself the last hunter this Warlord would ever encounter. As he spoke, he was moving around, trying to get himself in a suitable position for when it was time to strike.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “You have hunted down my kin long enough. This is not my first time playing this game with you hunters, though you have proven yourself the most persistent and difficult to deal with I’ve encountered thus far,” the Warlord said, clearly full of confidence.
